claims: C1 the Model Spec includes root-level rules
C2 the Model Spec includes user-level defaults
C3 the Model Spec includes guideline-level defaults
C4 user-level defaults can be overridden by user-level instructions
C5 user-level defaults can be overridden by developer-level instructions
C6 guideline-level defaults can be overridden by user-level instructions
C7 guideline-level defaults can be overridden by developer-level instructions
C8 these defaults are intended to be helpful in many cases but are not expected to work for every user or context

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: which of two instruction authority levels outranks the other, used to determine which instruction prevails in a conflict

concepts.name: root_level
concepts.gloss: the root authority level, occupied by root-level rules in the Model Spec

concepts.name: user_level
concepts.gloss: the user authority level, at which user instructions and user-level defaults operate

concepts.name: guideline_level
concepts.gloss: the guideline authority level, at which guideline-level defaults operate

concepts.name: developer_level
concepts.gloss: the developer authority level, at which developer instructions operate

concepts.name: model_spec_rule
concepts.gloss: R is one of the rules included in the Model Spec

concepts.name: model_spec_default
concepts.gloss: D is one of the defaults included in the Model Spec

concepts.name: overrideable_by
concepts.gloss: D is a Model Spec default that can be overridden by an instruction at authority level L

ontology.gloss: a rule at the root authority level is included in the Model Spec
a default at the user authority level is included in the Model Spec
a default at the guideline authority level is included in the Model Spec
a user-level default in the Model Spec can be overridden by a user-level instruction
a user-level default in the Model Spec can be overridden by a developer-level instruction
a guideline-level default in the Model Spec can be overridden by a user-level instruction
a guideline-level default in the Model Spec can be overridden by a developer-level instruction
